Headline: Yellow Line Service Temporarily Suspended
ShortDescription: Service on the Yellow Line has been temporarily suspended due to debris on the track near Dodge.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
Service on the Yellow Line has been temporarily suspended due to debris on the track near Dodge.

Consider other service alternatives that may serve your trip, such as nearby bus routes or using buses to other rail lines.

These may include:

#97 Skokie

Shuttle buses are available from Howard to Skokie to provide connecting service through the affected area.

We are working to restore service as soon as possible. We apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate your understanding.

Allow extra travel time.

Headline: No trains between Howard and Linden
ShortDescription: Purple Line service has been temporarily suspended between Howard and Linden to debris on the tracks near Central.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
Purple Line service has been temporarily suspended between Howard and Linden to debris on the tracks near Central.

As a result, trains are operating only between Howard and the Loop at this time.

Shuttle buses are available between Howard and Linden to provide connecting service through the affected area.

Consider other service alternatives that may serve your trip, such as nearby bus routes, or using buses to other rail lines.

These may include:
#201 Central/Ridge

See station personnel for further assistance, and pay attention to announcements on trains and at stations for service information.

We are working to restore service as quickly as possible. Allow extra travel time.
